# UIListLayout

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIListLayout")`

Arranges the `UIObject` children of its parent in a row or a column. Parent it next to the objects it arranges, not above them.

A child arranged by a layout keeps its `Size`; its `Position` is ignored.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AbsoluteContentSize` | `Vector2` | — | read-only | The space the children take after layout, in pixels. Use it to set the `CanvasSize` of a `ScrollFrame`. |
| `FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection.Vertical` | read/write | Whether the children are arranged in a row (`Horizontal`) or a column (`Vertical`). |
| `HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left` | read/write | The horizontal position of the children within the parent. |
| `HorizontalFlex` | `Enum.UIFlexAlignment` | `Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None` | read/write | What happens to leftover horizontal space: nothing, the children grow to fill it, or it is distributed between them. |
| `ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment` | `Enum.ItemLineAlignment.Automatic` | read/write | The position of each child across its line. `Stretch` makes every child as tall as its row or as wide as its column. A child's own `UIFlexItem` can override it. |
| `Padding` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | The gap between children. It does not add space around them; use `UIPadding` for that. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's size along the fill direction. |
| `SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder` | read/write | The order the children are arranged in. |
| `VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top` | read/write | The vertical position of the children within the parent. |
| `VerticalFlex` | `Enum.UIFlexAlignment` | `Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None` | read/write | What happens to leftover vertical space: nothing, the children grow to fill it, or it is distributed between them. |
| `Wraps` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the children continue on a new line when they run out of room, instead of overflowing. |
